scenes.vo: In April twenty twenty-six, a jury found Live Nation and Ticketmaster ran an illegal monopoly.

visual.sub:
LIVE NATION & TICKETMASTER
RAN AN ILLEGAL ONE, A JURY FOUND

scenes.vo: The jury found fans were overcharged by about one dollar seventy-two per ticket at major venues.

visual.sub:
EXTRA, PER TICKET
AT MAJOR CONCERT VENUES

scenes.vo: The Justice Department and thirty states had sued in May twenty twenty-four, over how Ticketmaster locks in venues.
Their method: pay venues upfront, then threaten to pull Live Nation's own concerts if they book a rival.

visual.headline:
THE CARROT
AND THE STICK
visual.source: Source: DOJ v. Live Nation Entertainment complaint, filed 23 May 2024

scenes.vo: Once a venue signs, fans have no other place to buy a ticket.

visual.sub:
ONCE A VENUE SIGNS,
FANS CAN'T BUY ELSEWHERE

scenes.vo: A monopoly doesn't need to hide. It just needs you to have nowhere else to go.

visual.display: A monopoly doesn't need to *hide.* It just needs you to have *nowhere* else to go.
